Capacity (MW).note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists Delray generator 11-1 at 71.1 megawatts nameplate, status operating, in service February 2000. The Michigan air permit staff report from 2023 (https://mienviro.michigan.gov/ncore/downloadpdf/-3126265583763517653) also gives a load rating of 71.1 megawatts for each turbine. GEM shows 71.0.

The exact frame model is not given.
